facts.fact: Treasury CS John Mbadi's budget speech proposed KSh 8.6 billion for the digital economy and creative industry (the digital superhighway package) for FY2026/27.
facts.system: Kenya national budget FY2026/27, digital economy and creative industry allocation

facts.fact: The FY2026/27 allocation of KSh 8.6 billion for digital economy and creative industry is lower than the KSh 12.7 billion set aside for the ICT sector in the 2025/26 budget.
facts.system: Kenya national budget FY2026/27, digital economy and creative industry allocation

facts.fact: KSh 4.3 billion of the FY2026/27 allocation goes to the World Bank-backed Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (part-financed by the Bank; the article does not say it is paid wholly by it).
facts.system: Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (KDEAP), FY2026/27 budget

facts.fact: The KDEAP allocation rose by KSh 600 million, from KSh 3.7 billion in 2025/26 to KSh 4.3 billion in 2026/27.
facts.system: Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (KDEAP), FY2026/27 budget
